title: Canonical coefficient comparisons in signed point-line coordinates
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For every finite intermediate field $E$, let $\mathcal O_E$ be its valuation ring, $\varpi_E$ a uniformizer, and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ ($n\ge1$). Choose compatible primitive $\ell^r$-th roots $\zeta_r\in k$ with $\zeta_{r+1}^{\ell}=\zeta_r$. Form all signed Tate twists as in [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], with $e=(\zeta_r)_r$, $e_{m,\mathcal O_E}$ its tensor generator for $m>0$, $e_{0,\mathcal O_E}=1$, and $e_{-r,\mathcal O_E}(e_{r,\mathcal O_E})=1$ for $r>0$; write $e_{m,A_{E,n}}$ for the corresponding residue generator. Set $V_{\mathcal O_E,m}=\Gamma(s,\mathcal O_E(m)_s)$, $V_{A_{E,n},m}=\Gamma(s,A_{E,n}(m)_s)$, and $V_{E,m}=V_{\mathcal O_E,m}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$.
For every integer $m$, the canonical sections-tensor map induced by the quotient of coefficient sheaves is an isomorphism
$$V_{\mathcal O_E,m}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{A_{E,n},m},\qquad e_{m,\mathcal O_E}\otimes a\longmapsto a e_{m,A_{E,n}}.$$
The integral-to-rational comparison for the point fiber [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] is the localization map on these coordinates. For every finite inclusion $E\subset E'$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, the canonical completed integral scalar-extension comparison [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension] gives isomorphisms
$$V_{\mathcal O_E,m}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_{E'}\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{\mathcal O_{E'},m},\qquad V_{E,m}\otimes_E E'\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{E',m},$$
taking $e_{m,E}\otimes b$ to $b e_{m,E'}$, where $e_{m,E}=e_{m,\mathcal O_E}\otimes1$. The analogous formula holds before rationalization. For negative $m$, these are the comparisons on sheaf duals normalized by evaluation equal to $1$ on the positive generator. They are the identity for $E'=E$ and commute with the canonical tensor associators for $E\subset E'\subset E''$. At algebraically closed coefficients the point fiber comparison is represented by these maps at any common finite stage and is independent of that stage.

proof.text: Use normalizedSectionGenerators with the prescribed root section. It gives a single family g at all finite coefficient fields, with the original positive tensors, negative evaluation, positive finite reduction, and compatibility with every fixed signed scalar map. Obtain the finite section isomorphisms z separately from finiteSectionComparison.

Use the explicitly constructed canonicalSheaf, canonicalIntegral and canonicalRational. The sheaf tensor formula follows by moving the tensor through the inverse ordinary-model comparison and applying integral_twist_base_change. The integral tensor formula is the pointSectionsTensor formula followed by that sheaf formula. Rational tensor normalization follows from pointTensorRationalization and the integral formula, with the coefficient one. Apply preservation of g to obtain both generator formulas. Rationalization compatibility is cancellation of an isomorphism with its inverse.

For negative finite reduction, apply the normalized dual-evaluation clause of signedTwistReduction_comparison to g in degrees -(r+1) and r+1. The integral evaluation equals one and the coefficient quotient preserves one. For localization on a times g, apply pointFibreRationalDown_existsUnique on the pure tensor of one with a times g. Tensor balancing moves a into the field factor.

Insert canonicalDerivedCoordinates to identify the actual rational normalization with size descent and exact-single transport, single.map of the constructed integral comparison with completedSectionsComparison, and the actual rational point scalar comparison with single.map of the constructed rational comparison.

The integral identity and tower equations follow from the constructed tensor formulas, twistScalarMaps_identity and twistScalarMaps_composition. Repeated use of the scalar-extension adjunction reduces equality to tensors whose new coefficients are one. The specified integral associator takes the double one tensor to the single one tensor. For rational identity and towers apply the coefficient adjunction as well, reducing to the rational tensor formula; use extendScalarsId_hom_app_one_tmul and the inverse of extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul. These are complete Lean proofs in PointTateFiberCanonicalComparisons.

Apply canonicalCommonStage at M and at N to identify the source representatives of the fixed twistPairComparison. The defining representative formula of pointQbarFibre gives heterogeneous equalities for both. Rewrite by the source equalities; transitivity gives equality of the two representatives. Thus independence follows without introducing another arbitrary comparison family.

    ∃ (g : ∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra (Padic l) F]
        [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F] (m : ℤ), integral D l F m)

        [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F] (r : ℕ),

        (a : F) • ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F,
          algebraMap (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F) F] g F m)) ∧
    (∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra (Padic l) F]
        [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F] (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L]

        (β F L ι m).hom.val.app U

        [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F] (m : ℤ),
